id: T2

class: mechanical

  - run: test ! -e src/Main.java && test ! -e src/FancyFrame.java && test ! -e src/GradientPanel.java
    timeout_s: 10
  - run: npx tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/cli.js --text | grep -qx 'Hello, World!'

## Objective
Delete the three Java files now replaced by the TypeScript port, so the repository contains only the TypeScript implementation.

## Interface
Delete `src/Main.java`, `src/FancyFrame.java` and `src/GradientPanel.java` (for example with `git rm`).

## Behavior
1. The three Java files no longer exist.
2. The TypeScript build still succeeds and `node dist/cli.js --text` prints `Hello, World!`.

## Invariants
All TypeScript files, `package.json`, `tsconfig.json` and `index.html` remain unchanged.

## Edge cases
None.

## Guardrails
Delete only those three files. Do not modify any other file.

## Out of scope
Any change to the TypeScript code.
